testsuite.name: com.slotting.admin.auth.DurableAuthenticationIntegrationTest

testcase.name: Token Family - Refresh rotation, reuse detection revoking family, and session termination
BE-017: Maximum-identity fingerprint produces a bounded 64-char digest fitting in varchar(128)
HTTP Routes - Token exchange, eligibility bearer derivation, and unauthorized rejection
Unpredictable challenges - Purpose and subject binding, replay prevention, attempt limits
Concurrency: Simultaneous refresh requests with identical token results in exactly one success
Password KDF - Adaptive PBKDF2 with salt, reject default pass, and legacy migration
Restart: Valid sessions and token family revocation status survive service recreation
